recovery.title: Recovery Centre
recovery.description: Review and restore supported changes made by SuperSonicCleaner
recovery.limits: Recovery covers recorded Windows DWORD privacy/registry values, scheduled tasks and service configuration. Permanent file deletion cannot be undone. Older or unsupported changes may have only a manual backup. Some restored settings require a restart.
recovery.loadError: Recovery history could not be read.
recovery.empty: No recorded changes on this page. New supported changes will appear here.
recovery.gameModeDescription: Game Mode has an active or pending recovery snapshot.
recovery.backupDescription: These backup files do not contain verified after-state information. Inspect them in the backup folder before restoring manually; importing them can overwrite newer settings. A backup file is not an OS restore point.
recovery.confirmDescription: SuperSonicCleaner will check the current state before restoring the recorded original value. Newer conflicting changes will be preserved. Administrator privileges may be required.
recovery.removeDescription: Remove this recovery record from local history? This does not change your settings or delete registry backups. SuperSonicCleaner will no longer be able to restore this change for you.
recovery.unreadable: This recovery record could not be read. It may have been written by another user account or damaged on disk.

registryBackups.title: Registry backups
registryBackups.description: SuperSonicCleaner saves the registry keys it is about to change. Targeted backups can be restored here. Full-branch exports can only be inspected in the backup folder, because importing them would roll back unrelated changes made since.
registryBackups.confirmDescription: SuperSonicCleaner will import the keys below. Values from the backup replace the current ones and missing keys and values are added back. Nothing else is deleted, except that restoring a pre-restore backup also removes the keys and values that the restore it undoes had added. Before importing, SuperSonicCleaner saves the current state of these keys as a pre-restore backup. Some changes take effect only after signing out or restarting.
registryBackups.restored: Restored. The previous state was saved to {{file}}.
registryBackups.restoredNoBackup: Restored. None of these keys existed before, so there was nothing to back up first.

blocked.full-export: Full-branch export. Restoring it would roll back unrelated changes, so it can only be inspected.
blocked.too-large: Too large to be a targeted backup.
blocked.format: Not in the registry export format SuperSonicCleaner writes.
blocked.deletion: Contains deletion entries, which SuperSonicCleaner backups never do.
blocked.forbidden-key: Contains keys outside the areas SuperSonicCleaner changes.
blocked.classes-root: Contains HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT keys, which merge the machine and per-user classes, so SuperSonicCleaner can't tell which one to restore them to. It can only be inspected.
blocked.unverified: This backup cannot be verified: it may have been changed since SuperSonicCleaner wrote it, so it can only be inspected.

receipts.volumeDelta: {{volume}} observed free-space change: {{size}} (also affected by other activity)
receipts.selectionContext: Cached entries in these categories: {{found}} · Not selected in this operation: {{unselected}}
receipts.title: Cleanup receipts
receipts.description: Recorded at deletion time. Each receipt covers one cleanup operation or batch.
receipts.empty: No cleanup receipts yet. Run a cleanup to record its outcomes.
receipts.loadError: Could not read cleanup receipts. Existing data has been preserved.
receipts.saveError: Cleanup finished, but its receipt could not be saved.
receipts.units: Counts refer to selected entries, which may be folders or native operations. Removed bytes can include partially cleaned folders. Logical file size is not the measured increase in free drive space.
receipts.retryLifetime: Retries use still-cached selections for up to 30 minutes. Exclusions and age protections are checked again. After expiry or restart, run a fresh scan.
receipts.pathsOff: Path logging was off for this run. Only categories and outcomes were retained.
receipts.truncated: {{count}} additional outcomes are included in totals but omitted from the bounded detail list.
receipts.retryDescription: Eligible cached entries will be checked against current protections and permanently deleted if still eligible. This creates a new receipt.
receipts.clearDescription: This permanently removes saved receipts and their retry information. Scan history and the separate deletion log are unchanged.

emptyStateDescription: Scans and cleanups appear here after their first run, with date, duration and outcome. Cleanup receipts are in the Receipts view.
confirmClearScanDescription: The paths in the deleted-files log are cleared too. Cleanup receipts are kept. This cannot be undone.

deletedFiles.exportFailed: Could not export the deleted-file list.
deletedFiles.truncatedHint_one: This folder held 1 more entry past the per-folder listing cap. It was deleted but not listed.
deletedFiles.truncatedHint_other: This folder held {{formatted}} more entries past the per-folder listing cap. They were deleted but not listed individually.
deletedFiles.emptyRecorded: No paths were recorded for this run.
deletedFiles.disabledHint: Deletion logging was off, so the paths from this run were not recorded. To record them from now on, turn on “Keep a log of deleted files” in Settings › Cleaning preferences.
